verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.github.com (HTTP 200, 'GitHub Docs'), the vendor documentation site that hosts GitHub Mobile's docs. The evidence does not show that this file covers GitHub Mobile specifically; it reads as general GitHub platform docs. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt indexes GitHub Mobile documentation, other agent-oriented docs for the mobile app (e.g. markdown/LLM-friendly pages), and independent corroboration of agents using it.
